english: This is sudden, but what kind of present\nwould make you happy to get?
A present!?\nAre you giving me something?
Huh? Ah, um, no, that's not it...
I'm thinking about a present for Aoi-neesama.\nI just can't decide...
For Aoi...\nI'm sure she'd be happy\nwith anything from you, Kurumi.
Anything, huh...\nHaruka said the same thing.
'Anything's fine' is the\nhardest answer to work withhh.
Then why not make her something by hand?
Handmade...?\nYeah, handmade.\nThat might be good!
Yeah, going with that!
Alright, let's get started right away!\nYou'll help me, right?
Huh!?\nS-sure, but what are we making?
Hmm... let's see...\nSomething Aoi-neesama would like...
Let's see... something she can use every day.\nSomething neesama would be happy with...
How about a pendant?
A pendant sounds great!\nSo what should I help with?
Let's see...\nThere's a lot to do, but...
Could I ask you\nto go buy the materials?
Um, the chain for the pendant...\nand...
Clasps, wire, beads... okay.\nI wrote it all on this memo, so go for it!
Uh, um...\nH-hey! This much!?
I'll pick out the main gem myself.\nCome on, please!
I can't carry all this.
Huh, you can't...? Then take this!\nTake my specially-made shopping bag!
With this bag,\nany amount stores compactly, and it\neven reduces the weight...
Do you have enough money?
It's fine.\nI calculated it all\nto fit within budget.
And put in a little effort yourself\nfinding cheap shops.
Anyway, I'm counting on you!
I'll draw up the blueprints in the meantime.
Can you hurry?\nThe longer I think about it, the more elaborate\nit gets, and we might run out of materials!
O-okay...
Materials are gathered, we're all set.
With this much, we should be able\nto make something good.
You're better at this than I thought!\nYou saved me.
Th-thank you.
Alright, let's get to work!
H-hey.\nCome to think of it, aren't you making one for Haruka?
Huh, Haruka? Th-that's...\nI don't owe Haruka any thanks or anything...
If anything, SHE should thank ME!\nHonestly, she's always so clumsy...
She causes trouble for Aoi-neesama too.\nShe really puts me through it!
So it's fine! This time the present\nis for Aoi-neesama!
But won't Haruka be sad if she's the only one left out?
It's her own fault! If she wants one,\nshe'll have to put in the effort...
Otherwise, even I...\nactually...
Actually?
Huh?\nN-nothing!!
Anyway!!\nThis time I'm NOT giving Haruka one!!
Is that how it is...
You're persistent, you know! Fine,\nsince we've got the chance, I'll tell you everything about Haruka.
First, she sleeps in every morning!\nHow can a high schooler\nnot get up in the morning?
She barely avoids failing every test,\nshe's a ditz and always forgets things!
A-and, she sneaks her striped panties into...\nmy change of clothes...
(The way she keeps listing things,\nmaybe Kurumi actually likes Haruka)
Ughh, why does Haruka make me\nlook after her so much!?
You're not very honest with yourself.
W-what's that supposed to mean...
I'm always honest!\nI only ever say true things!
You know a lot about Haruka.
I-it's not like I learned it because I like her...
We're together every day, so\nof course I'd know this much, I mean, um...
A-anyway, this conversation is over!\nThis time we're making it for Aoi-neesama!\nGot it!?
Yeah, got it.\nSo what should I help with?
Right, we're short on time, so\nwe need to get going right away!
I made the blueprints, so\ncan you help while looking at these?
(The blueprints are super detailed, but\nis there anything I can actually help with?)
Hey, your hands stopped.\nHurry up!
Y-yes!
How'd the pendant turn out?
Hmph, glad you asked.
Look! It's perfect!
Yeah, going with the cat pattern was the right call.\nAoi-neesama's sure to love it!
Th-this is it?
Yeah. Something wrong with it?
Don't tell me you're a dog person.\nHah, I wonder which Aoi-neesama is...
Come to think of it, I never asked.\nCareless of me...
Ughhh, if you noticed that,\nyou should've said so sooner!!
N-no... that's not it.\nIsn't it a little... childish?
Huh!? Childish...?
Y-yeah, I thought so...
It was bothering you.
A little. Aoi-neesama and I have\ndifferent ages and tastes...
That's why I thought getting you\nto help might be a good idea.
I see, that's what it was.\nI wondered, since I figured you\ncould do it alone, Kurumi.
Hmm, how can I make it\nbetter from here?
How about changing the colors?
Right. More grown-up colors\ncould really change the vibe.
Okay! I'll try out\na few patterns.
How about changing the pattern type?
Cats are no good after all?
Hmm... right. Even with cats,\nwhat about doing it as a silhouette?
If we're making it, I want it perfect, so\nsorry, but will you help me till the end?
Of course.
Thanks!\nThen I'll have to redo\nthe blueprints from scratch.
Um, so...
Sorry, but could you go buy\nmore materials?
I want to make several patterns this time,\nso it's a bit more than before...
And the budget's running low.\nFind something cheap and good, will you.
Be back before I finish the blueprints!\nUm, like, 5 minutes?
Huh...
Okay, I'm counting on you!!
Okay...
We're getting close to the final version.\nLet's build it all at once.
Um... so,\ncan you cut that chain?
Yeah, leave it to me.\nI've gotten pretty good at making these, right?
Well, for this short a time,\nthat's impressive.
Though I think my teaching\nbeing so good is part of it♪
Anyway, this time it's perfect.\nI hope Aoi-neesama likes it...
But man, you really went to\nall this trouble, Kurumi. Impressive.
It's nothing. I like making things,\nit's fun.
This much isn't nearly enough\nto show my gratitude to Aoi-neesama.
As the ones who summon Twin Angel,\nthe responsibility is huge.
Whatever form it takes, I want\nto support them.
And believe it or not, I'm technically\nin the same grade as Haruka and the others. ...I skipped grades, though.
R-right...
What's with that face?\nSure, I'm younger than her in actual age, but\nI'm way more put-together than Haruka!
That again?\nHaruka's kind, and she can understand everyone's feelings.
That alone makes her qualified\nto summon Twin Angel, I think.
I know that.\nI know Haruka's energy\nbrightens everyone up...
But that's not enough.\nNot enough, or... it worries me...
That recklessness is dangerous.\nAs Aoi-neesama's partner, I want her\nto be stronger, calm and collected.
Don't you think you're overthinking it?
What do you mean?
Exactly what I said.
I'm asking what\nthat MEANS!
Am I really overthinking it?\nIt seems like common sense to me...
That doesn't matter.
You say that, but!\nWith her being so carefree, what'll happen from here on out...
If something happened to those two, I...
So I just want Haruka to get stronger.\nThat's all I'm saying...
But there are all kinds of definitions of strength.
Huh?
Now, I'll go make some tea, and\nwe'll keep working after a breather.
O-okay...
Definitions of strength...
Like this... and like this...\nDone!
Yeah! This time it's not just cute,\nit's got a grown-up feel too.
After everything,\nAoi-neesama's sure to...!
I wasn't much help, but...\nI'm glad I could help out.
No, that's not true.\nAbout the design - I never\nwould've noticed that on my own...
You really saved me. Thanks!
Huh, you can say thank you properly after all.
Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
Honestly, here I am thanking you,\nhow rude.
Of course I can say thank you.\nNaturally!
Then how about properly thanking\nHaruka for everything, too?
Huh? Th-that's...
That's different.\nThis time it's Aoi-neesama's present...
Oh, I get it. The only person you're not\nhonest with is Haruka.
W-w-w-what are you saying!?\nThat's not true at all!?
Honestly, what basis do you even have\nfor saying that...
But well, Aoi-neesama might\nworry, so making the same thing\nfor Haruka too, maybe...
For Haruka, maybe the full-cat\ndesign like the first one...
B-but, if I did that,\nHaruka might get a big head...
What's there to hesitate about?
I'm not hesitating.\nJust...
When it comes to actually giving Haruka a present,\nwhat excuse should I give her, like...
Let's make the present?
R-right.\nIf I only give one to Aoi-neesama, neesama might\nfeel awkward about it...
Yeah, that makes sense.\nI guess I could make one for Haruka too!
How about being a little more honest?\nYou know your true feelings, right?
Well, whatever.\nAnyway, here you go.
What's this...\nAh, materials...?
Don't tell me, you bought all these materials\nwith that in mind...
That's as far as I can help.\nThe rest is up to you, Kurumi.
H-hey, wait!!\nHold on!!
Geez! What am I supposed to do\nwith all these materials!!
But... thanks.
Ah! Perfect timing.\nWill you look at this?
What're you spacing out for?\nCome on, how is it? It's lovely, right?
A pendant in a different color than last time?\nDid you make Haruka's too?
T-that's right. Only because YOU\nkept going on about it!
Anyway, how's the workmanship?
It might be a little childish, but\nfor Haruka this might be better...
I made it red-based, to match\nHaruka's image, anyway.
Haruka likes cats... and I\nadded a striped design too.
She'll definitely love it!\nAnd now, a present from me to you, Kurumi.
Huh, for me...?
This is... huh?\nIt's just like the pendant I made...?
Don't tell me YOU made this.\nWhen...?
Kept it secret from you, Kurumi.\nIt'd be lonely to be the only one without one, right?
Th-that's...\nyou idiot...
Did it make you happy?
W-well. The finishing's a bit rough\ncompared to mine, but...
I'll give you a passing grade!!
Hehe, presents are nice even\nwithout a reason.
Somehow, you've made me realize\nall kinds of things. Thanks...
I'm glad you approve.
Don't get too cocky.
Look closely!\nThe soldering here is a total mess...
But I made it pretty well, right?
Well, of course - you had\nmy blueprints!
And look! The soldering here is sloppy.\nIt'll fall off right away!
That's fine.\nJust seeing you be honest with yourself\nmakes me happy, Kurumi.
You're a little\nlike Haruka...
Anyway, I really appreciate\nwhat you did this time!
I'll properly return the favor next time,\nso look forward to it!
I wonder what she'll give me?\nCan't wait.
Hey!
What is it?
The presents, obviously.
I gave them to the two of them the other day.
I tried the surprise from\nyour idea, too.
I snuck them into\ntheir desk drawers...
They were both so surprised.\nHaruka almost cried...
Your kindness reached them.\nGiving the presents was worth it, right?
Well, if I'd only given one\nto Aoi-neesama and not Haruka,\nshe'd probably have cried anyway...
They were happy to have matching ones,\nso in the end I think it worked out.
Yeah.
W-why are you grinning?\nDid I say something weird?
Nothing at all.
With that face, that's completely\nunconvincing!
Hmph, whatever.\nYou'll pay for that later.
I just think it's funny.
What's so funny?\nHow rude.
If you say that,\nHaruka's face when she found\nthe present was way funnier!
Anyway, I owe\nyou one this time.
No no, I didn't do anything.\nIt's all thanks to your hard work, Kurumi.
I-I didn't...
I did work hard, sure.\nBut you're the one who pointed out\nwhat I didn't notice.
You're really honest with everyone\nexcept Haruka.
Shut up!!\nThat's not relevant right now!
Honestly, here I am\ntrying to thank you...
I don't need thanks, but\nhow about being more honest with Haruka?
I said drop it!!\nLeave me alone!!
Hmph! Bye!!
I wonder why Kurumi got so mad...
I did promise, after all...
That outfit is the promise?
It's the outfit I'm wearing for the\nacademy festival event. I designed it.
I-I made it thinking about\nwhat you'd like...
Come on, come over here!\nI can't thank you properly like this...
No one's around. ...Okay.\nU-um...
W-welcome home, Master.\nWhat would you like to order...?
'Order'...? What's going on?
I-I said it's my thank-you, didn't I!?\nJust decide what you want!
No wait. Ugh...\nPlease decide, Master...
T-then...\nIced coffee, please.
Iced coffee, then.\nUnderstood...
Th-then, with this gum syrup,\nI'll cast a spellll!!
Here I goooo!!
Become deliciouuus!\nKuru-Kuru Miracleee!!
Th-that Kurumi doing this...
But... I wanted Master to be happy...
Master, am I a bad maid?
What can I do to make Master happy...?
For Master, I'd do anything...
Ah... my magical iced coffee is going to get cold...
Huh, cold...? It's iced?\nW-well, whatever... *gulp gulp gulp*...
Wow, Master, great drinking!\nNumber one in Japan!!
Did my love taste good...?\nHehe...
So, how about some food next?
I tried making it for Master.\nMy special omurice...
U-um, this time...
Then I'll cast a spell on this one too...?
Uh, um...\nis that spell really necessary?
Yes... because it's a spell I'm casting on myself as well...
K-Kurumi...?
I want to be more honest...\nhere goes! Kuru-Kuru Miracleee!!
Wake up!!\nSeriously. How long are you going to sleep?
U-uhh...\nKurumi, you're actually really hardworking, huh?
Huh!? More importantly,\nyou put in the effort to wake up!
You were calling my name in your sleep...\nHonestly, what were you dreaming about?
Yeah, I guess.\nIt was just a dream...
I even prepared something to thank you\nproperly...
Huh? Did you just say something?
Nothing!\nGo wash your face already!
